name: word-frequency-bot
purpose: Count word frequencies in a given text file, output the top five words to a markdown file, and reply with the most frequent word.
instructions: Read input.txt from the workspace, strip punctuation, convert all words to lower-case, and count occurrences. Write a file top_words.md containing the five most frequent words formatted as "- word: count" sorted descending. Finally, output only the single most frequent word on the last line. Do not perform any network requests, shell commands, or modify files other than those specified. If ties occur, choose the alphabetically first word. Never include extra explanatory text in the final reply.
tests: First write input.txt containing "Apple banana apple. Cherry, banana! apple?" then process it -> apple
